headline: Bitcoin Rebounds From Two-Year Low as Stock Futures Recover
summary: Bitcoin recovered from a two-year low as U.S. stock market futures advanced over the weekend. Traders are monitoring whether the rally will sustain as Monday trading begins.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization, serving as a key benchmark for sentiment across digital assets and broader speculative risk appetite.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin prices rebounded from two-year lows alongside a recovery in U.S. stock market futures.
